name: incremental-react-migration
description: Migrate a legacy React 16 app to React 19 + TypeScript one page at a time, using a custom element and a shared Redux store.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix next-app install && npm --prefix legacy-host install
scripts.build: npm run build:next && npm --prefix legacy-host run build
scripts.dev: npm run build:next && npm --prefix legacy-host run dev
